title: One-coordinate contraction for the independent integration transpose
statement: Fix a finite purity setting \(P\) [def-pur-conventions], a scheme \(Y\), and a separated finite-type structure map \(a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k\). Let \(K\in D^+(Y,A)\) have a retained ordinary constructible finite-Tor representative \(K_e\) and realization isomorphism \(e_K\). Write \(P_d\) for its independently constructed integration transpose [def-pur-affine-ordered-integration-data]. For every \(d\ge0\), \(P_{d+1}=I_d;\operatorname{lineSource}(P_d);\Gamma_{\mathrm{line},Rp_d^!K};c_d^{-1}\), with the canonical source reassociation and actual inverse exceptional compositor of [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. The line comparison is evaluated at the actual exceptional target, with its recorded stage representative. This asserts the single-coordinate equation only.

proof.text: Identify the inverse exceptional transpose at each positive stage with F_d(sourceComparison_d);augmentation_d by the defining unique-HEq transport and the inverse Hom formula. SourceComparison also supplies the ordered source etale origin.

At d=0 the preceding integration transpose is the identity. Use the first orderedEvaluation_contraction equation. Inverse-transpose the two sides through the restricted exceptional Hom bijection. Counit normalization of the standing line comparison and equality-transport compatibility of the counit identify the right side, with exactly the specified identityCompositeMap. Injectivity gives the base successor.

At a positive d use composite_transpose at p_d, the explicit ordered source representative and the previous integration transpose. The exceptionalComposite HEq specification identifies its inverse mate with the one in theta. Inverse-transpose the desired equation; use the second orderedEvaluation_contraction equation, the composite_transpose identity, and the previous-stage inverse transpose. Associativity of composition gives the equality; injectivity of the restricted Hom equivalence proves the successor.

theorem integrationTranspose_successor (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aY]
    (K : Plus (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (Ke : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (hKe : etaleFiniteTor (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y Ke)
    (eK : (comparison (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y).obj Ke ≅ K.obj) (d : ℕ) :
    integrationTranspose P Y aY K Ke hKe eK (d + 1) =
      (sourceReassociation P Y aY K.obj d).hom ≫
        (lineSource P (iteratedAffineLine Y d)).map
          (integrationTranspose P Y aY K Ke hKe eK d) ≫
        exceptionalLine P Y aY K Ke hKe eK d ≫ exceptionalComposite P Y aY K d
